verdict.rationale: Phoenix can run headlessly. It starts from the terminal with `uvx arize-phoenix serve` and deploys via Docker, Kubernetes or Helm with version-pinned images. It also has a CLI (`npx @arizeai/phoenix-cli setup`) and modular SDKs for programmatic tracing, span querying and prompt sync. Dataset evaluators are described as test cases that automatically score experiment outputs, forming a harness similar to a unit test suite, which fits automated regression checks. Missing for 10: explicit CI documentation (e.g. GitHub Actions examples, pass/fail exit codes or gating on eval scores), a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.
